brand.subline: CV, cover letter and application tracker in one app – free and open source.

cv.title: CV from building blocks
cv.text: Maintain it once in your master profile, pick what goes into each application.

letter.title: Cover letter and title page
letter.text: Following DIN 5008, with a matching title page.

designs.title: Designs from classic to modern
designs.text: One click changes the design without retyping anything.

export.title: PDF and Word export
export.text: The whole portfolio as PDF, CV and cover letter as Word.

tracker.title: Application tracker
tracker.text: Status, interviews and the exact version you sent, at a glance.

brand.ai: AI help is optional: with your own key, a local model, or by copy and paste.

setup.title: Welcome to {{product}}
setup.intro: Create the first account to get started.
setup.adminHint: This first account automatically becomes the administrator. You create further accounts yourself later.
setup.tokenHint: It is in the server’s log at the first start – on Unraid under Docker → Vitafolio → Logs.

login.title: Sign in
login.codeIntro: Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator app.
login.codeHint: Without the app, a recovery code works too (once).

forced2fa.title: Set up two-factor sign-in
forced2fa.intro: The administrator requires a second factor for every account.
forced2fa.hint: As soon as the setup is done you can continue. Nothing else is possible before.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor sign-in
twoFactor.onText: Signing in also asks for a code from your authenticator app.
twoFactor.offText: A second factor protects your account if the password falls into the wrong hands.

mode.title: Operation
mode.server: Server version: sign-in with an account, reached in the browser.
mode.desktop: Windows program: your data stays on this computer, no sign-in needed.

theme.title: Colour scheme
theme.text: Light, dark, or automatic following your system setting.

password.title: Change password
password.text: Enter the current password once and the new one twice.
password.failed: The password could not be changed:

totp.title: Two-factor sign-in
totp.textOff: Protect your account additionally with an authenticator app.
totp.textOn: Your account is protected with an authenticator app.
totp.intro: You need an authenticator app (e.g. on your phone). After the setup you get ten recovery codes for emergencies.
totp.startFailed: The setup could not be started:
totp.qrLabel: QR code for setting up the authenticator app
totp.step1: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app, or type in the key by hand.
totp.step2: Then enter the six-digit code shown by the app.
totp.codesWarning: Keep these recovery codes safe. Each one works once and will not be shown again.
totp.disableIntro: To turn it off, confirm with your password and a code (from the app or a recovery code).
totp.disableFailed: Two-factor could not be turned off:

schedule.sectionText: Decide when the app backs up your data on its own.

schedule.beforeShutdownHint: One last backup before the app shuts down.

retention.problemDaily: Please enter a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}.

preview.planned_one: {{count}} planned backup in the next 7 days.
preview.planned_other: {{count}} planned backups in the next 7 days.
preview.automaticOff: Automatic backup is off – no automatic backups are planned.

backups.desktopNote: Backups only run while the program is open. Whatever was missed in the meantime is caught up at the next start (if enabled).

result.unchanged: Nothing has changed since the last backup – no new one was made.
result.uploaded: Uploaded: {{file}}. It is now in the list and can be restored.
result.tooBig: The file is too large: {{size}} (at most {{max}} allowed).

reauth.passwordHint: For safety: this action concerns the data of all accounts.

dialog.sensitive: The file contains the data of all accounts, including the protected passwords. Keep it safe.
dialog.downloadText: The backup from {{date}} is downloaded as a file.
dialog.currentText: A fresh backup is made first and then downloaded as a file.
dialog.uploadChecks: It is checked: it has to be a valid backup of this app, not from a newer version. Afterwards it is in the list; nothing is restored until you trigger that there.
dialog.restoreIntro: The backup from {{date}} ({{kind}}) is restored. This is what happens:
dialog.restoreSafety: The current state is saved as a backup of its own first (“Before restore”) – so you can get it back.
dialog.restoreSignOut: Everybody is signed out and has to sign in again.
dialog.restoreReloadDesktop: The program then reloads and shows the restored state.
dialog.restoreReplace: All data created after this backup is no longer in the running app afterwards.
dialog.deleteIrreversible: This cannot be undone. The running app is not affected.

backup.failed: The backup failed. Details are in the server's log.
backup.unchanged: Nothing has changed since the last backup.
backup.too_new: This backup is from a newer version of the app and cannot be restored here.
backup.not_found: This backup does not exist (any more).
